about.title: About the Foundation
about.description: The "Foundation Of Canon Buddhism" is a completely non-profit organization and all work is done by volunteers free of charge.
about.gift: This is our gift to all humanity.
about.mission_title: Our mission is to provide access to Buddhist canons

mission_items.readable_format: in a format convenient for reading;
mission_items.translations: with translations in different languages, including the original;
mission_items.open_license: with an open license and free for distribution in any form;
mission_items.no_affiliation: not belonging to any community, tradition or school;
mission_items.canons_only: without any extra materials, only canons of all traditions.

about.translations_text: Translations are performed by a large team of participants with constant rechecking and under the editorship of educated laypeople and monks who speak the languages. If you find an error in the translation or a typo, please click the "report translation error" button in the sutta. If you speak one of the languages at a high level and would like to participate in the Foundation's work as a volunteer, please join us.
about.web_version_title: Why a web version and not a printed or electronic book?

web_version_items.easy_edits: this allows making edits to translations in a few clicks to improve them;
web_version_items.disputes: convenient to display controversial translation points;
web_version_items.language_comments: easier to manage language switching and comments on texts;
web_version_items.collaboration: work together as a large team;
web_version_items.no_printing: avoid problems of reprints and versions - keep access free for everyone, as the digital format does not require printing costs;
web_version_items.add_materials: add new materials and translations as they are completed.
